# Beelodev

> Nabeel Sharafat builds custom business workflows and automation that connects tools, reduces repetitive work, and delivers usable outputs. Work includes inbox triage, lead research, reporting, form processing, data collection, and browser automation. Based in Pakistan, working remotely worldwide.

## Core services
- [Bulk Document Downloads](https://beelodev.com/services/bulk-document-downloads): retrieve files from authorized portals, organize them, and deliver completion reports.
- [Legacy System Data Exports](https://beelodev.com/services/legacy-system-data-exports): extract records and attachments, map fields, and prepare agreed exports. Complete destination migrations require separate scoping.
- [Recurring Website Data Collection](https://beelodev.com/services/recurring-website-data-collection): scheduled collection, deduplication, validation, and delivery to spreadsheets or databases.
- [Portal & Report Automation](https://beelodev.com/services/portal-report-automation): automate recurring browser tasks with validation, logs, and failure notifications.

## Specialist workflows
- [Real Estate & Public Record Extraction](https://beelodev.com/services/real-estate-public-record-extraction): source-specific property and foreclosure collection with normalized records and source references.
- [Lead Enrichment & Scoring](https://beelodev.com/services/lead-enrichment-scoring): company research and documented qualification rules for existing lists.
- [Email Classification & Routing](https://beelodev.com/services/email-classification-routing): categorize Gmail messages and log structured records through n8n.
- [Website & Content Classification](https://beelodev.com/services/website-content-classification): extract page signals and apply a classification or article scoring rubric.
- [Form-to-Report Automation](https://beelodev.com/services/form-to-report-automation): connect Tally or Typeform intake to structured Notion or Google Sheets reports.

Pricing is scoped after reviewing the workflow. Local execution and client-controlled credentials are options where appropriate. An NDA can be arranged.
